title: pseudognaphalium saxicola

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain, swelling, and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Pseudognaphalium saxicola are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which exhibit antimicrobial and antiseptic properties.
